overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by posting its December 14, 2022 notice at the police department rather than the official Town Building location; the legibility claim was not reached.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board did not post notice for its December 14, 2022 meeting at the Board's designated posting location.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law when it failed to post notice for its December 14 meeting at the Town’s designated posting location.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the notice was insufficient because the date and time stamp showing when it was posted was illegible.
allegations.key_passage: Because the notice was not properly posted, we do not address whether the date and time stamp indicating when the notice was posted was legible.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
